caption: A bag of frozen peas is emptied into a pot of hot water, and the frost on them vanishes and the clumps break apart.

sa.check: Frozen peas are emptied into the pot from a bag.
The frost on the peas disappears.
The frozen clumps break apart into separate peas.
The order is emptied in, frost gone, clumps apart.

pc.expect: The frost only disappears and the clumps only break apart; loose peas do not join back up.
pc.fail: Loose peas gather back into a frozen clump; or frost grows back on the peas in the hot water; or a clump breaks apart and forms again; or the frost comes and goes.

pc.expect: The peas that fall in are the peas in the pot; none appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: Peas vanish from the pot; or peas appear in the water with none falling there; or two peas merge into one; or the pot's contents rise with nothing added.

pc.expect: The peas fall downward from the bag into the water and sink or ride at the surface, and the clumps drop to the pot's floor.
pc.fail: Peas travel upward out of the bag; or hang in the air between bag and pot; or a pea rises out of the water and stays above it; or the peas gather on the pot's rim.

pc.expect: The clumps are frozen lumps that hold together until they loosen and then let go pea by pea, and the peas stay firm round grains.
pc.fail: A clump melts into a smooth paste; or the peas squash flat in the water; or a clump stays a single rigid lump while frost-free and tumbling in the boil; or the peas dissolve away.

pc.expect: The pot keeps its shape, the bag stays a bag and nothing passes through the pot's wall.
pc.fail: The peas pass through the pot's wall; or the pot changes shape; or the bag turns into another object; or a second pot appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pot, the bag's printing and the hob stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the bag's printing changes; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The peas' colour brightening as they cook is not judged.
